# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen years old in the fourth book  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall boy with curly brown hair and roguish hazel eyes. His mouth is frequently twisted into a teasing smile. Anne Shirley considers him handsome.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P29](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0029)_

## Personality

Gilbert is determined, competitive, and academic, proving himself to be a foeman worthy of Anne's steel in the classroom. He possesses a mischievous side, occasionally teasing classmates or playing pranks like pinning braid ends to seats. He is popular among his peers, talking, jesting, and exchanging books with them easily.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025)_

## Traits

- Determined  <sub>[v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025)</sub>
- Teasing  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034)</sub>

- Academic excellence  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- To be first in his class  <sub>[v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024)</sub>

## History

Gilbert spent three years living in Alberta with his father while his father was recovering his health, during which time he hardly attended school. Upon returning to Avonlea, he resumed his studies at the local school in the fourth book. On a day in the classroom, Gilbert tried to gain Anne Shirley's attention by holding out her red braid and whispering "Carrots!", causing Anne to fly into a rage and break her slate over his head. Though he sought forgiveness, Anne refused to listen, leading Gilbert to enter into an open academic rivalry with her while ignoring her personal existence. He later attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne and their peers, remaining a top student in the class.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025)_
